<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Nature's Precision](/Feats.aspx?ID=5425) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 66

**Archetype** [Beastmaster](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=50)

**Prerequisites**
[Beastmaster Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=1900); animal companion with an [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526) or [finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=602) unarmed attack

</column>

---

Your companions pick at an enemy's weak points. When your companion strikes a [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) creature with an [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526) or [finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=602) [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack, it deals an additional 1d4 precision damage (2d4 if the animal companion is specialized). If the companion already deals precision damage, combine the precision damage.
